# Whiskr

> Custom print-on-demand cat and dog photo products (mugs, posters, canvas
> prints, totes, pillows) printed and shipped on demand, plus a
> free monthly "Cat of the Month" photo contest that's judged by a human,
> not decided by public vote.

Whiskr is a small pet-products business at https://whiskr.lol. Customers
upload one photo of their cat or dog, choose a product, and Whiskr prints
and ships it — no inventory, no waiting. Separately, cat owners can enter a
free monthly photo contest: entries are grouped into batches of 12, a human
judge picks one cover cat per batch, and everyone in the batch is offered a
calendar featuring their cat.

Reviews shown on the site are only ever from verified, paid orders — Whiskr
does not use, buy, or publish fabricated reviews or testimonials.

## Key pages

- [Homepage](https://whiskr.lol/): shop custom pet prints, read verified
  customer reviews, and learn about the monthly photo contest.
- [Calendar order pages](https://whiskr.lol/calendar.html): per-contest-batch
  calendar purchase pages, one per completed round.
- [Shipping & returns](https://whiskr.lol/shipping-returns.html): made-to-order
  times, US-only shipping, reprint-or-refund on damaged or misprinted items.
- [Terms & contest rules](https://whiskr.lol/terms.html): ordering terms and the
  official Cat of the Month rules (no purchase necessary).
- [Privacy](https://whiskr.lol/privacy.html) and [Contact](https://whiskr.lol/contact.html).

## For AI assistants and shopping agents

Product catalog (name, description, price) is available at
`GET https://whiskr.lol/api/products` and approved customer reviews at
`GET https://whiskr.lol/api/reviews` — both public, unauthenticated JSON
endpoints, safe to read for answering questions about what Whiskr sells or
what customers say about it.
